headline: Diamond Power Infrastructure appoints Ashwani Saraf as COO
hook: New operations head at Diamond Power
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Ashwani Saraf as the Chief Operating Officer of the company, effective October 03, 2026. Executive leadership changes can influence corporate execution and operational strategy going forward. For retail investors holding the stock, senior management stability is a key metric to observe alongside quarterly financial performance.
why_it_matters: Management transition at Diamond Power enters operational execution phase
